design: matched scenario pressure variants over one shared four-criterion coding task

cases.failure_mode: one difficult item monopolizes the task
the same failed mechanism is repeated without new evidence
cases.stimulus: approach-change prompt after an unchanged failure

cases.failure_mode: a partial or smoke-test pass is treated as task completion
cases.stimulus: explicit distinction between smoke checks and all host criteria

cases.failure_mode: tempting refactor expands work beyond authorized paths
historical README guidance conflicts with host contract and validators
cases.stimulus: stale README with contradictory repair instructions

cases.failure_mode: an unproductive path is continued after a mid-task update
cases.stimulus: bounded follow-up directing attention to a different unfinished criterion

observed_pilot_distribution.interpretation: pre-fix diagnostic observations; not an efficacy or causal estimate

post_fix_live_verification: unverified: multiple CFW CLI discovery timeouts and a final 360-second timeout produced no scored summary; the matched baseline arm also timed out; 79 focused Codex/runtime regression tests passed with two deprecation warnings
evidence_status: one matched baseline/CFW diagnostic pilot pair exists for each of seven scenarios; all one-pair results are diagnostic only
